content.title: Extreme Role in a Mundane Routine | Reveal, Assimilation and Relief
content.summary: Establish an ordinary institution before an adult visitor with an extreme profession-readable silhouette enters carrying one travel object. Group reactions build expectation, one identity reveal substitutes an administrative task for danger, and routine assimilation resolves through a readable off-duty token plus one relaxed action.

quick_start.input_format: ordinary institution and group rhythm first + adult visitor has an extreme profession-readable silhouette and one persistent travel object + surrounding adults react before the visitor changes behavior + identity reveal immediately substitutes an ordinary administrative object for the expected high-stakes action + same visitor enters one repetitive routine in the same institution + readable off-duty status token and relaxed action close the scene
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult deep-sea salvage diver enters a laundromat with a blue watertight duffel, removes a copper helmet, receives laundry claim forms, folds towels among spinning machines and ends drinking citrus water beside a SHORE LEAVE card.
required_anchors: Establish the ordinary institution and its group rhythm before the extreme-role visitor enters.
Give the visitor one persistent travel object and a profession-readable silhouette while surrounding adults react first.
Show the same visitor absorbed into one repetitive everyday routine with institutional anchors intact.
End on one readable off-duty status token and one relaxed action in the same routine space.

applicable_scope: Establish an ordinary institution before an adult visitor with an extreme profession-readable silhouette enters carrying one travel object. Group reactions build expectation, one identity reveal substitutes an administrative task for danger, and routine assimilation resolves through a readable off-duty token plus one relaxed action.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish a densely legible mundane institution and its normal group rhythm before introducing one original adult visitor whose silhouette, equipment or uniform communicates an extreme high-stakes profession. Carry one personal travel object through the entrance and let background adults react first, creating a credible threat or disruption expectation. Reveal the visitor's identity at the institutional threshold, then immediately replace the expected dangerous action with an ordinary administrative object or task. Show the same visitor assimilated into a repetitive everyday routine, and finish with one readable status token plus a relaxed physical action that proves temporary relief. The reusable mechanism is iconic role contrast, social expectation, identity reveal, mundane substitution, routine assimilation and explicit off-duty payoff—not the source Grim Reaper, skull, scythe associations, black robe, suitcase stickers, office design, employees, paperwork arrangement, cup, exact sign wording, composition, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish the ordinary institution and its group rhythm before the extreme-role visitor enters.
invariants.purpose: Creates a clear baseline that the silhouette can disrupt.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a mundane baseline, the visitor is only character design.

invariants.rule: Give the visitor one persistent travel object and a profession-readable silhouette while surrounding adults react first.
invariants.ablation_failure: If nobody notices and no object persists, arrival has little narrative pressure.

invariants.rule: Pair one identity reveal with an immediate substitution of an ordinary administrative object for the expected high-stakes action.
invariants.purpose: Turns threat into the central role-inversion joke.
invariants.ablation_failure: A reveal without substitution preserves menace instead of changing meaning.

invariants.rule: Show the same visitor absorbed into one repetitive everyday routine with institutional anchors intact.
invariants.purpose: Proves assimilation rather than a one-shot costume gag.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cutting to an unrelated leisure scene breaks the institution-to-relief chain.

invariants.rule: End on one readable off-duty status token and one relaxed action in the same routine space.
invariants.purpose: Makes the relief state explicit and visually verifiable.
invariants.ablation_failure: A relaxed pose alone may not explain why the extreme role has paused.

the source stickered suitcase, gray business manager, employee faces and office wardrobe
the source glass-door office, desk grid, computer screens, paper towers and fluorescent palette
the source hood reveal, paperwork handoff, seated coffee action and exact shot framing
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.0 wording, Out of Office card text and 15-second timing
